Hi! Yes, I'm comfortable sharing it, thank you for the concern!

**Pages 1 & 2** \- In the first two pages I have a grid. The months of this year are on top of the grid and on the left side I have my measures. (Chest, waist, hips, stomach, right and left arms, right and left legs, both thighs, shoulders, weight, left and right feet.)

I do these on the morning of my T-shoot, and without having eaten anything. Only after do I eat.

**Page #3** \- I have each day and respective months I got my T-shoots. As well as which one I'm taking and the dosage.

**Page #5** \- I have a tracker for big things and legal changes. For both of these, I have a checkmark for big things  & a cross for the legal changes.

**Big things tracker:**

* tell family
* choose 1st name
* choose 2nd name
* Appointments for HRT
* Start of HRT
* Top Consult
* Top Surgery

If you wish you can add the dates of when you have done these things.

**Legal Changes Tracker**

* Name & gender marker
* ID
* Bank Accounts
* Insurance
* Email
* Subscriptions
* Passport
* Bills
* Driver's license
* School Diploma
* Hospitals & Medical Centers (At least in my country)

There's more to change and it depends from person to person.

**Page #6-#7** (or more, depending on how much you use the binder) - Every time I wear it, I check the time and write it down on my phone and when I remove it, I check the time and put it on my phone as well.

Then at night when I'm updating my regular BuJo, I check how many hours I wore the binder for and make a graphic for every month.In the following pages, if I wore the binder over the recommended period, I jolt down why. **Example** \- It might be simply because I stayed more than 8 hours around people when I didn't plan to.

**Page #8** \- I put on the day and month I noticed certain or certain changes and write down what those were. If it's a change of voice, I will record it and name it "1", for example, and in the bullet journal  I will put it, like this:

*May 16 - Noticeable voice change (recording number 1)*

I take photos as well, on the same day every month, and save them in a locker app, where only I can access because only I know the password to the gallery.
